topic: JARVIS-1: Open-World Multi-Task Agents with Memory-Augmented Multimodal LLMs

key_points: JARVIS-1 uses pre-trained multimodal language models to map visual observations and text instructions to plans
Outfitted with multimodal memory combining pre-trained knowledge and actual game survival experiences
Capable of completing over 200 different tasks in Minecraft using human-like control and observation space
Nearly perfect performance on short-horizon tasks
5x reliability improvement over SOTA in ObtainDiamondPickaxe long-horizon task
Self-improvement through life-long learning paradigm enabled by multimodal memory
Published at NeurIPS 2023 and IEEE TPAMI 2024
200+ citations on Semantic Scholar
406 GitHub stars, 30 forks
Java-based implementation for Minecraft modding
Open-source project with active maintenance (last updated July 2026)
Topics: agent, language-model, minecraft
Project page with demo videos and execution examples
Demonstrates JARVIS-1 across multiple Minecraft biomes (Plains, Birch Forest, Jungle, Savanna)
Shows generated language plans for tasks across Wood, Stone, Iron, Gold, Diamond, Redstone, Armor, Decoration, Food groups
Compares against DEPS (interactive planning with LLMs) and MCU (task-centric evaluation framework)
Shows epoch-based learning progression where plans improve over time
Presented at NeurIPS 2023 conference
Leverages pre-trained Vision-Language Models for multimodal input interpretation
Multimodal memory draws from ingrained knowledge and real-time game experiences
Completion rate surpasses VPT by up to 5x in diamond pickaxe task
200 citations on Semantic Scholar
Published as journal article in IEEE TPAMI (Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence)
12 authors from PKU, UCLA, BUPT, BIGAI

stats.fact: JARVIS-1 can complete over 200 different tasks in Minecraft

Nearly perfect performance on short-horizon tasks
406 GitHub stars and 30 forks on CraftJarvis/JARVIS-1 repository
200+ citations on Semantic Scholar as of July 2026
Diamond-related task success rate increased by nearly 3x compared to DEPS (8.99% vs 2.42%)
JARVIS-1 requires only 2-3 rounds of re-planning vs DEPS requiring 6+ rounds
12 authors from Peking University, UCLA, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, and BIGAI

angles: JARVIS-1 represents a paradigm shift from single-task to multi-task open-world agents through memory-augmented multimodal LLMs
The multimodal memory architecture enables life-long learning — agents improve over time without forgetting previous knowledge
Comparison of Minecraft AI agents: VPT (behavioral cloning), Voyager (skill library + GPT-4), DEPS (LLM planning), Steve-1 (instruction following), and JARVIS-1 (memory-augmented multimodal)
JARVIS-1 bridges the gap between LLM-based planning and embodied control in open-world environments
The 5x reliability improvement in long-horizon tasks demonstrates the practical value of multimodal memory for complex planning
Open-source availability (406 stars) makes JARVIS-1 accessible for further research and development
keywords: JARVIS-1 vs Voyager vs DEPS comparison
